title: Arsenal: Weaponry
description: Overhauling Your arsenal with a load of new melee weapons and powerful enchants
body:
![Arsenal: Weaponry](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2706dfc72928068ed08977ef54a44be9ad3a8ecd.png)

Arsenal: Weaponry expands Minecraft combat by adding a wide variety of new weapons, including long swords, hammers, battle axes, javelins, glaives, daggers, spears, and more. Each weapon is available in multiple material tiers such as iron, diamond, and netherite, with support for Re-Enforced Metals adding steel, platinum, and rose gold weaponry sets with much more to come. Designed for combat-focused gameplay and modpacks, Arsenal gives players more choice, variety, and fighting styles beyond the standard Minecraft weapons. Not to mention the support for Better Combat, RUNIC: Enchants, Re-Enforced Metals, and Avarice: Gates Of Ascension.

### This mod is experienced best with the better combat mod:
[![Better combat mod link](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/62c893b19cc147adaf2b5a829659d6d954c0692f.png)
](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-combat)
